title: Acceptability Guide for Rental Buildings and Leases — LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy
content:
LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy tiers accept a rental building by its size, the leases in use, the age of the building and the age of its roof. Every tier also requires that the building is not the named insured's own primary residence, and each tier has a limit on paid claims in the past 36 months.

## Acceptance values

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most dwelling units in one insured building | 2 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Lease types accepted | annual lease | annual lease, month-to-month | annual lease, month-to-month | annual lease, month-to-month | annual lease, month-to-month | annual lease, month-to-month, short-term |
| Shortest rental term that is not a short-term rental (days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Oldest building accepted at binding (years from year built) | 100 | 100 | 100 | 80 | 80 | 100 |
| Oldest roof accepted at binding (years) | 25 | 25 | 20 | 20 | 18 | 20 |
| Most paid claims in the past 36 months at entry | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| Building must not be the named insured's primary residence | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Book-of-business minimum at entry | none | none | none | none | none | the portfolio minimum of live LandlordGuard policies |

## Lease types

A lease shorter than 30 days is a short-term rental. Only LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio lists short-term rentals among its accepted lease types; LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic accepts annual leases only.

## Hypothetical screening examples

| Hypothetical building | Tier asked for | Reading of the table |
|---|---|---|
| Three units, annual leases | DP-1 Basic | more units than the 2 the tier accepts |
| Four units, month-to-month leases | DP-2 Broad | within 4 units; month-to-month accepted |
| Roof 19 years old at binding | DP-3 Premier | older than the 18-year roof limit |
| Building 90 years old | DP-3 Special Plus | older than the 80-year building limit |
| Rented by the week | DP-3 Special | short-term rental, not an accepted lease type on this tier |
